title: census.py fetch answers error: InvalidURL for a source url with a literal space, so its check never asks the server
goal: census.fetch_once quotes a url's spaces (the url is stored with a literal space in two live public sources, S-56n7jfkc and S-5qxktcen) so such a source gets the server's answer, not error: InvalidURL

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import census; st=census.fetch_once('https://example.invalid/a?$filter=x eq 1',5,100)[0]; sys.exit(1 if 'InvalidURL' in str(st) else 0)
